result.scope: ONE eligible BC1 cell only; no global K16/K9/moving prior, physics, cache or observations

scaling.observed_cell: face0/cell0 has35candidates and2regions;0.08093s exact enumeration+certificates. This is a small cornercell, not a worst-case runtime estimate.
scaling.per_region_clipping: K*(N-K) selected/outside halfplanes, exact Fraction arithmetic; no combinations enumeration.
scaling.facet_crossing: Per positive-length facet, bound outward step by all O(N^2) affine ranking roots, crossing simultaneous ties together.
scaling.certificate: Exact area exhaustion and pairwise positive-area overlap checks; pairwise certificate grows O(R^2) in region count.
scaling.larger_faces: H0 eligible fixed-patch faces have35,65,35,91candidate nodes respectively; more candidates/regions and rational bit sizes may dominate. No timing extrapolation asserted.
scaling.degeneracy: Strict rational seed lies on a parabola and avoids all nonidentical affine tie lines; coincident sites use global-node stable ordering. Any missing area, overlap, zero-area traversal or region budget failure aborts.
scaling.bounded_enumeration: maximum_regions10000; partial results never become normalized weights.

remaining_scope: No other eligible cells, full K16 fixed-patch distribution, K9 distribution, paired opposite-face prior or moving-law pushforward constructed.
For two-patches, retain ordered conditional groups and exact opposite-face factorization: first face1/F, independent first/second eligiblecell+UV factors; no second1/F.
For moving patches, a geometry mask cannot replace the latent face/amplitude/tangent law; these continuous nuisance roles remain separate.
Any future bulkconstruction requires exact certification on EVERY eligiblecell, all positiveareas retained, and original face/cell prior weights. Root must authorize new scope.
